programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. programme.title: Fortress Britain With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts, Professor Danielle George and Dr Onyeka Nubia tell the story of Henry VIII's obsession with invasion from Catholic Europe through the physical reminders that remain to this day. At her base in Walmer Castle, Alice gets her hands on a vast hoard of a Tudor coins and a five- hundred-year-old jousting scorecard. Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone
programme.desc: Yellowstone's wilderness is home to remarkable predators, from bears and wolves to golden eagles, prairie rattlesnakes and mountain lions, their legends shaped by both truth and myth. This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

programme.title: A Gentleman In Moscow

programme.title: Banter

When a conflict with promising rookie Jack spirals out of control, and the pressures of his home life become unbearable, Riz finds himself at a crossroads. With the season's final match on the line, he must confront his own pride, his pain, and the people he has pushed away.

programme.title: Tour Auvergne-rhone-alpes 2026

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.title: The Lost King

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. This is a place where humans and animals were once locked in conflict but changing attitudes has seen former enemies become allies.

programme.title: Fortress Britain With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts, Professor Danielle George and Dr Onyeka Nubia tell the story of Henry VIII's obsession with invasion from Catholic Europe through the physical reminders that remain to this day. At her base in Walmer Castle, Alice gets her hands on a vast hoard of a Tudor coins and a five- hundred-year-old jousting scorecard. Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone

This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

programme.title: Michael Mosley: Truth About Sleep
programme.desc: We should spend almost a third of our lives sleeping, but we don’t, and Britain is one of the most sleep-deprived countries in the world. Presented by chronic insomniac Michael Mosley, this feature takes us on a fascinating journey finding out what sleep is, what happens when we don’t get enough, and looks at surprising solutions to help us get more.

programme.title: The American Fuhrer
programme.desc: A German emigrant who stylized himself as Hitler's deputy in America in the 1930s, marching his troops through American cities and filling Madison Square Garden with supporters. programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: Delfin

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. programme.title: Michael Mosley: Truth About Sleep
programme.desc: We should spend almost a third of our lives sleeping, but we don’t, and Britain is one of the most sleep-deprived countries in the world. Presented by chronic insomniac Michael Mosley, this feature takes us on a fascinating journey finding out what sleep is, what happens when we don’t get enough, and looks at surprising solutions to help us get more.

programme.title: The American Fuhrer
programme.desc: A German emigrant who stylized himself as Hitler's deputy in America in the 1930s, marching his troops through American cities and filling Madison Square Garden with supporters. Neither Hitler nor the FBI can stop him. In the end, a love affair brings him down. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

Neither Hitler nor the FBI can stop him. In the end, a love affair brings him down. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches

Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

This is a place where humans and animals were once locked in conflict but changing attitudes has seen former enemies become allies.

programme.title: Fortress Britain With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts, Professor Danielle George and Dr Onyeka Nubia tell the story of Henry VIII's obsession with invasion from Catholic Europe through the physical reminders that remain to this day. At her base in Walmer Castle, Alice gets her hands on a vast hoard of a Tudor coins and a five- hundred-year-old jousting scorecard. Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone
programme.desc: Yellowstone's wilderness is home to remarkable predators, from bears and wolves to golden eagles, prairie rattlesnakes and mountain lions, their legends shaped by both truth and myth. This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

programme.title: A Gentleman In Moscow

With the season's final match on the line, he must confront his own pride, his pain, and the people he has pushed away.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.title: The Lost King

Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone
programme.desc: Yellowstone's wilderness is home to remarkable predators, from bears and wolves to golden eagles, prairie rattlesnakes and mountain lions, their legends shaped by both truth and myth. This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

programme.title: A Gentleman In Moscow
programme.desc: The Count's world is turned upside down when an unexpected arrival is placed in his care. As he struggles to attend to his duties, things become more difficult when the Bishop hears of the arrangement and is hellbent on tearing everything apart.

programme.title: SBS World News Late
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Banter
programme.desc: Riz is a tough, burned-out rugby player whose passion for the game is his only escape. When a conflict with promising rookie Jack spirals out of control, and the pressures of his home life become unbearable, Riz finds himself at a crossroads. With the season's final match on the line, he must confront his own pride, his pain, and the people he has pushed away.

programme.title: Tour Auvergne-rhone-alpes 2026
programme.desc: All the action from Stage 5 of the 2026 Tour Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes (formerly Criterium du Dauphine), as the peloton takes on a 198 km route from Saint-Chamond and finishing in Villars-les-Dombes.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: An amateur historian defies the stodgy academic establishment in her efforts to find King Richard III's remains, which were lost for over 500 years. The Lost King stars Sally Hawkins, Steve Coogan and Harry Lloyd.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. Nominated for three Academy Awards in 2002, and Winner of Best Supporting Actor (Jim Broadbent). Directed by Richard Eyre and also stars Judi Dench and Kate Winslet.

In Ulladulla, the boys get a taste for the cheesemaking life with Rosie and Angel, and relax on the picturesque deck with a wine and cheese in hand, soaking up the mid-afternoon sun. Inland at Milton, the boys are put to the task of eating as little produce as possible when chocolate making with Jo and Dan. Mark and Derek indulge in a heart-to-heart kayaking down the Kangaroo Valley River.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: You don't have to be intimidated to make fish tacos at home. Rachael is going to make a crispy flake cod fish taco with refried beans that you're going to love.

programme.sub-title: Bowls, Brains And Gold Of The Sea

programme.desc: Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.title: On Country Kitchen
programme.desc: Mark and Derek learn about the overabundance of sea urchin, and explore a new type of sustainable farming in Berrima. The boys also have a go at bee keeping.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese And Special Sauce
programme.desc: Rachael is cooking up some serious comfort food today and with this much flavour, you'd never guess that these robust bull's eye burgers topped with onions and blue cheese sauce are plant-based.

programme.desc: Ainsley explores Greek-Bahamian flavours and a wine cellar with a 'million-dollar wine rack' before heading into his kitchen to cook up pork skewers.

programme.title: Michael Mosley: Truth About Sleep

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Until recently, Portugal’s traditional ewe’s milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programme.desc: The remaining nine bakers must think beyond the bar as they create a nougat-filled chocolate confection in a surprising shape as they vie for the coveted Golden Whisk.

programme.title: Michael Mosley: Truth About Sleep
programme.desc: We should spend almost a third of our lives sleeping, but we don’t, and Britain is one of the most sleep-deprived countries in the world. Presented by chronic insomniac Michael Mosley, this feature takes us on a fascinating journey finding out what sleep is, what happens when we don’t get enough, and looks at surprising solutions to help us get more.

programme.title: The American Fuhrer
programme.desc: A German emigrant who stylized himself as Hitler's deputy in America in the 1930s, marching his troops through American cities and filling Madison Square Garden with supporters. Neither Hitler nor the FBI can stop him. In the end, a love affair brings him down. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

Little old Yorkie Dexter proves that you don't have to be young and beautiful for someone to fall in love and take you home, and Paul works his magic befriending an anxious Golden Retriever called Skye who comes to Battersea after escaping from a house fire.

programme.title: When Champollion Meets Ramses Ii
programme.desc: An exceptional documentary on the magical encounter between Champollion and Ramses II. When Champollion, the genius who unlocked the secret of hieroglyphs, embarks on his first expedition to Egypt and meets Ramses II in the sumptuous temple of Abu Simbel, his fascination for this civilisation reaches its peak. Follow in the footsteps of the brilliant and passionate man who succeeded in "cracking the Egyptian code" and allowed the world to finally read into the history of one of the greatest and most powerful civilisations.

programme.desc: A journey from the foothills of the Patagonian Andes, where pumas hunt guanacos on the wild grasslands of the steppe before climbing up into the dizzying heights of the Andes, which is home to the third largest expanse of ice in the world. This is a place where humans and animals were once locked in conflict but changing attitudes has seen former enemies become allies.

programme.title: Fortress Britain With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts, Professor Danielle George and Dr Onyeka Nubia tell the story of Henry VIII's obsession with invasion from Catholic Europe through the physical reminders that remain to this day. At her base in Walmer Castle, Alice gets her hands on a vast hoard of a Tudor coins and a five- hundred-year-old jousting scorecard. Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone
programme.desc: Yellowstone's wilderness is home to remarkable predators, from bears and wolves to golden eagles, prairie rattlesnakes and mountain lions, their legends shaped by both truth and myth. This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. Mark and Derek indulge in a heart-to-heart kayaking down the Kangaroo Valley River.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: You don't have to be intimidated to make fish tacos at home. Rachael is going to make a crispy flake cod fish taco with refried beans that you're going to love.

And Maeve visits the Baldino family at L'Abruzzese Pasta in Adelaide to learn how all the various shapes of extruded pasta are made.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment. In this gastronomic road trip of a lifetime, Adam travels along the untouched beauty of Australia’s Western Coast, through the baking desert of the Red Centre and onto the tree changer’s paradise of northern New South Wales, and even hops over the ditch to New Zealand, taking in secret destinations that most city-dwellers wouldn’t even know exist. Tonight, Adam begins his culinary road trip in the northern tip of Western Australia, discovering food heroes who are putting community first, and the delights of mud crab and pearl meat.

programme.desc: Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

programme.desc: Until recently, Portugal’s traditional ewe’s milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese, Serra da Estrela. Dating back to pre-Roman times, this ancient cheese is still made from ewe’s milk and curdled with the juice of cardoon thistles.

programme.desc: We should spend almost a third of our lives sleeping, but we don’t, and Britain is one of the most sleep-deprived countries in the world. Presented by chronic insomniac Michael Mosley, this feature takes us on a fascinating journey finding out what sleep is, what happens when we don’t get enough, and looks at surprising solutions to help us get more.

programme.title: The American Fuhrer
programme.desc: A German emigrant who stylized himself as Hitler's deputy in America in the 1930s, marching his troops through American cities and filling Madison Square Garden with supporters. Neither Hitler nor the FBI can stop him. In the end, a love affair brings him down. With the help of Kuhn's distinctive propaganda and the overwhelming press response, the documentary tells the unusual story of propaganda in the USA.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches
programme.desc: In the final months of the Second World War, the concentration camps were evacuated before the advancing Soviet and Allied troops could reach them. Of the 700,000 prisoners held in them in January 1945, between 250,000 and 300,000 would perish on so-called death marches. They were massacred by guards escorting the columns, as well as by many civilians, and this often took place on German territory.

programme.title: Patagonia
programme.desc: A journey from the foothills of the Patagonian Andes, where pumas hunt guanacos on the wild grasslands of the steppe before climbing up into the dizzying heights of the Andes, which is home to the third largest expanse of ice in the world. This is a place where humans and animals were once locked in conflict but changing attitudes has seen former enemies become allies.

programme.title: Fortress Britain With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: Professor Alice Roberts, Professor Danielle George and Dr Onyeka Nubia tell the story of Henry VIII's obsession with invasion from Catholic Europe through the physical reminders that remain to this day. At her base in Walmer Castle, Alice gets her hands on a vast hoard of a Tudor coins and a five- hundred-year-old jousting scorecard. Danielle visits Henry's mighty castle at Deal and witnesses the awesome power of the cannons built to defend England, whilst Onyeka gets within touching distance of the iconic Mary Rose.

programme.title: Saving Yellowstone
programme.desc: Yellowstone's wilderness is home to remarkable predators, from bears and wolves to golden eagles, prairie rattlesnakes and mountain lions, their legends shaped by both truth and myth. This episode explores the daily lives of three elusive species and what makes them thrive. Drawing on research from the Universities of Idaho and Wyoming, we examine humanity's complex relationship with these animals and how we can coexist safely.

programme.title: A Gentleman In Moscow

programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Banter

With the season's final match on the line, he must confront his own pride, his pain, and the people he has pushed away.

programme.title: Tour Auvergne-rhone-alpes 2026

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing. As she learns to write, Nina uncovers her family's history, experiences the long-suppressed grief of her long-lost mother, and gains a deeper sense of self.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: This comedy-drama film, written and directed by Taika Waititi, follows Ricky, a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive in this hilarious and heartfelt adventure. Stars Sam Neill, Julian Dennison and Rima Te Wiata.

programme.title: Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: Featuring an all-star cast, this is the charming, critically-acclaimed adaptation of the classic Jane Austen novel about five sisters in a British family ruled by a mother determined to marry her daughters into money. The lovely Keira Knightley received an Oscar nomination for her performance as the clever Elizabeth Bennett. Donald Sutherland, Academy Award®-winner Judi Dench and Academy Award-nominee Brenda Blethyn also star.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel, Jane Eyre, this adaptation tells the story of the titular character (Mia Wasikowska), a former ophan who now works as a governess for the wealthy and moody landowner, Mr. Rochester (Michael Fassbender).

programme.title: L'incroyable histoire du facteur Cheval: The Ideal Palace
programme.desc: Based on the incredible true story of Joseph Ferdinand Cheval (Jacques Gamblin), comes the remarkable tale of a simple postman who spent 33 years crafting the magnificent 'Ideal Palace'. Everyday Cheval travels along the river Drome from village to village, quiet and alone he enjoys the solitude of his rounds, daydreaming about a world full of wonder he can only imagine through postcards. After his wife, Philomena (Laetitia Casta) gives birth to their daughter Alice, Cheval decides to build Alice a palace fit for a princess. With only his bare hands, his love for his daughter and the dedication of his wife, he starts carefully collecting stones and begins building the historically classified monument.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Kaakkaa Muttai: The Crow's Egg
programme.desc: Follows the life of two boys, Periya (J. Vignesh) and his younger brother Chinna (Ramesh), who have grown up in a slum. With their father in jail, their mother brings them up alone. One day, Tamil star T.R. Silambarasan opens up a new pizza shop nearby, and the boys decide that by any means possible, they will gain entry into the upmarket pizza shop and buy a slice of pizza with their own money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Lost King

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. programme.desc: Following on from his cook’s tour through Japan, Adam Liaw returns to the screen to give Australia and New Zealand the Destination Flavour treatment.
